name: luna-x
description: Luna X — AI Social Media Scheduler
author: Ardere Media LLC <giovanni@arderemedia.com>

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Luna X uses your microphone for voice commands to create and schedule social media posts hands-free.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Luna X can access your camera for content creation and social media posts.
extendInfo.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Luna X accesses your photo library to select images for your social media posts.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Luna X searches your Desktop for media files to post.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Luna X searches your Documents folder for media files to post.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Luna X searches your Downloads folder for media files to post.
extendInfo.NSMoviesFolderUsageDescription: Luna X searches your Movies folder for video content to post.
extendInfo.NSMusicFolderUsageDescription: Luna X searches your Music folder for audio content to post.
